author: Magic
name: Magic Gem
description: A gem: a plugin a project lists by name. Make it at src/Gems/<Name>.

authors.description: Who made the gem, shown beside it as Magic starts it.

native.description: A C library that the gem builds and binds: the name of its shared library and of the class of its C# API. Empty for no C library.

repository.description: The git repository of the C library.

gitTag.description: The tag of the C library to build.

headers.description: The headers of the C library to bind, paths in its repository. Empty for include/<native>.h.

includePath.description: The folder in the repository of the C library whose declarations are bound.

cmakeOptions.description: The CMake arguments that build the C library as a shared library, with a semicolon between each two.

postActions.description: Adds the gem to the solution's Gems folder, as Visual Studio does when it makes one.

manualInstructions.text: Add the gem to src/Magic.slnx, in its Gems folder.
